Our story

Local enough to care. Built to be dependable.

We are Maria and Matthew, a husband-and-wife team, parents of five, and animal lovers with Diesel the Cane Corso and two cats, Nemo and Coffee.

I’m not in the count. I’m the mascot.

We know a yard is part of your home, not just another stop on a route. That is why we built Purge Pros around the practical details: straightforward pricing, communication before arrival, property instructions, and a gate-closure photo after service.

Our focus is dog waste removal for local homeowners across Indianapolis and 25 surrounding communities, with a custom quote for kennels and commercial locations. As we grow, the standard should still be felt in every visit.

Fair questions

Who is coming to my yard?

Are you insured, and who performs the service?

Yes. Purge Pros carries business insurance, and field service is performed by background-checked W-2 employees trained to our service and property-care standards, not random gig workers.

You receive a notification before arrival, and the person servicing your property is identifiable as part of the Purge Pros team.

Do I need to be home during service?

No. As long as the approved service areas are safely accessible and we have the instructions we need, you can continue with your day. We send a heads-up text before arrival and a gate-closure photo after the completed visit.

How do you handle pets, gates, and property access?

We save your approved pet, gate, and property-access instructions so the technician knows how to enter and secure the service area.

Gate security: After the visit, we close the gate and send a photo showing it secured.

Pet notes: Treats are provided only when owner-approved, and allergy or no-treat instructions are documented.

Sanitation: Tools and footwear are treated between yards to reduce cross-property contamination.

Unsafe conditions: Reactive, protective, or escape-risk dogs must remain inside. We may pause a visit if safe service is not possible.

Do I have to sign a long-term contract?

No long-term contract or minimum number of visits is required. There is no cancellation fee, and nothing to pay back if you stop. Charges for service already provided remain due.
